summary.text: A Southern Border mountain that holds Tie clan city and the Demon Suppression Tower at its peak.

claims.text: Tie clan city sits on the upper half of the mountain. Tall thick blackrock walls extend thousands of li. Rock houses and steel towers line up and climb toward the peak. On the peak area stands a majestic steel tower over three hundred metres tall, with almost a hundred floors, rustic and ancient in design: the Demon Suppression Tower.

Days after her father’s death, Tie Ruo Nan speaks with the sitting Tie Clan leader in the clan leader pavilion; that pavilion sits at the peak under heavy guard, with little ordinary traffic and vigilant patrols. Rock houses and steel towers climb the upper half of the mountain toward that peak.

On Wan Cheng mountain’s peak area stands a majestic steel tower whose aura is likened to holding up the heavens. The tower is famous in the southern borders and all over the world, and even in middle continent many people know of it; it is named the Demon Suppression Tower. It stands over three hundred metres tall with almost a hundred floors, rustic and ancient in design, and since it was built Tie clan has imprisoned hundreds, thousands, and even ten thousand demonic Gu Masters there. Tie Ruo Nan tells the clan leader that Wan Cheng mountain peak has a demon suppression tower, and that her heart has one too, because she will walk the path her father could not finish.

A later scene returns to Southern Border, Tie clan, Wan Cheng Mountain, where Tie Ruo Nan passes a final killer-move test in an unassuming valley under a supreme elder’s guidance and is taken as a disciple toward immortal cultivation under the Iron Mask true inheritance. The same elder’s words place her father among that inheritance’s earlier chosen seeds. Tie Mian Shen later states that Tie clan’s Demon Suppression Tower once contained a Seven Illusions Demon Immortal, and that the clan learned many secrets of the Seven Illusions true inheritance without obtaining its contents.
Tie Ruo Nan later recalls closed cultivation inside Demon Suppression Tower.
She says she consulted many clan seniors about immortal ascension and is eighty to ninety percent confident of passing.
